table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	ID=0,
	Item_Num = I.CustomICode,
	Item_Name = LEFT(I.Name, 18),
	Item_Name2 = LEFT(I.PackingDesc, 18),
	Land = 0,
	AddItem=NULL,
	fix_price= CASE WHEN I.AllowSaleInDecimalQty = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE CAST(I.SalePrice * CASE WHEN :ai_priceindecimals = 2 THEN 100 ELSE 1 END AS NUMERIC(18,0)) END,
	piece = CAST(I.PrefferedSaleQty AS INT),
	unitprice=CASE WHEN I.AllowSaleInDecimalQty = 'Y' THEN CAST(I.SalePrice * CASE WHEN :ai_priceindecimals = 2 THEN 100 ELSE 1 END AS NUMERIC(18,0)) ELSE 0 END,
	weight=CASE WHEN I.AllowSaleInDecimalQty = 'Y' THEN 0.000 ELSE 1 END,
	fmark=NULL,
	pos_kind=NULL,
	pos_flg=(SELECT WS.ScaleID FROM WeighingScale WS WHERE WS.weighingscalecode = :ai_weighingscalecode),
	pos_code=I.CustomICode,
	dateprint=NULL,
	limit_day=NULL,
	limit_time=NULL,
	sale_start=NULL,
	sale_price=NULL,
	sale_day=NULL,
	total_weight=NULL,
	total_price=NULL,
	total_print=NULL,
	mg_id='root',
	info=NULL
FROM 
	Item I
WHERE
	CASE :as_grouping 
	WHEN 'M' THEN I.ManfCode 
	WHEN 'C' THEN I.ICatCode 
	WHEN 'L' THEN I.ICCode 
	WHEN 'P' THEN I.PackCode 
	END IN (:ai_groupcode) AND
	LEN(I.CustomICode) <= (SELECT WS.itemendpos - WS.itemstartpos + 1 FROM WeighingScale WS WHERE WS.WeighingScaleCode = :ai_weighingscalecode)
ORDER BY
	Item_Num
